name: lanterdev
description: Engineering skills for specification writing and lazy-first design. Complements superpowers, and forks its process skills only where they need to differ.

interface.shortDescription: Specification writing and lazy-first engineering skills
interface.longDescription: lanterdev adds skills that superpowers does not cover, starting with spec-writing: one requirement per sentence, a named actor, RFC 2119 keywords in capitals, and stable traceability IDs. It forks a superpowers process skill only when that skill must behave differently.
